[14/15 Regression] ICE after error dealing consteval
Take:
```
consteval int id (int i) { return i; }

void
g (int i)
{
  1 ? 1 : id (i) ^ 1; // { dg-error "call to consteval function|'i' is not a constant expression" }
}

```
